listenings.text: Yeah, look, I am happy with that one. I have been working on my backhand since the start of the season, so about eight months, and today it finally paid off. I have not been travelling much lately, to be honest, because of a back injury, so this is only my third event this year. The good news is the back has been feeling strong for about six weeks now. And the same sponsor since I was thirteen, by the way. They stayed with me the whole time I was out, and that means more than the result today.

He has been training with me for two years now, and something changed about three months ago. He has been arriving twenty minutes earlier and he sits on the sand and watches the water before he paddles out. Nobody told him to do that. His scores have been going up ever since. And the other thing, which matters more to me: I have not been seeing him give up when a session goes badly. A year ago one bad wave finished his morning. Now he just goes again.
